info.title: Doca client API
info.summary: Device-agnostic API for thin clients (watches, phones, glasses, kiosks, headless scripts) and agents on the tailnet.
info.description:
Machine-readable companion to `PROTOCOL.md`, which remains the normative specification.

Every operation carries `x-scope` — the token scope(s) it requires — and the `x-events` extension lists every push event type with its payload schema.

Clients **must ignore unknown fields, event types, block types and choice types**; additive changes do not bump the major version.

Generated by the running server (v2.6.0); fetch the live copy from `GET /api/v1/openapi.json`.

Push channel: SSE stream (Accept: text/event-stream) or JSON poll
get.description: With `Accept: text/event-stream` (or `stream=1`) the response is a Server-Sent Events stream: a `hello` event, replayed durable events, then live events; `: ping` comments every heartbeat. Otherwise a JSON page of pending events. `Last-Event-ID` is honoured as `since`. Because browser EventSource cannot set headers, `?access_token=` is accepted here only.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Last sequence number processed; everything ≤ since is acknowledged.

families.read: Read snapshots and receive push updates for a surface
families.command: Invoke a command (and confirm prompt outcomes that run it)
families.interact: Receive prompts, select choices, confirm/back, send messages
families.vars: Write own variables document (self) or read any (*)
families.sensors: Report sensor samples (report) or read them (*)
families.media: Upload media (upload) or read any media (*)
families.artifacts: Read artifacts delivered to this device
families.devices: Device administration: pair, list, revoke, rotate (admin)
families.agent: Agent-facing API: raise prompts/alerts, request sensors, deliver outcomes and artifacts

revoked.note: Followed by an SSE `close` frame; forget the token.

resync.note: Your cursor predates retained history: refetch capabilities, prompts and snapshot, then continue from `cursor`.

x-sse.note: Each event frame is `id: <seq>`, `event: <type>`, `data: <EventEnvelope JSON>`. Comments `: ping <ms>` are heartbeats.
